speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are here for a pruritic rash on your bilateral upper extremities; can you tell me how long this rash has been present and if you have noticed any new soaps, detergents, or plants you've been exposed to recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient complains of a pruritic rash on both upper extremities that has been present for 5 months. She notes that the rash occasionally worsens but has not completely resolved at any point. She denies any recent illnesses and mentions that she has not started any new medications or come into contact with any new substances that she is aware of.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Not yet determined; I need to rule out autoimmune causes like lupus or dermatomyositis given the chronicity and location.
